title: BzzBzzClientHelper
description: A client-side quality-of-life mod for Minecraft featuring waypoints, a Skyrim-style compass, fullbright, inventory/container helpers, death markers, durability warnings, an inspector HUD, and an in-game config.
body:
# Bzz Bzz Client Helper

**Bzz Bzz Client Helper** is a client-side quality-of-life mod for Minecraft.
The mod adds practical convenience features without completely destroying the vanilla feel of the game.

The focus is on better navigation, faster inventory handling, and small helpful HUD features for survival, multiplayer, and longer adventures.

## Features

### Skyrim-like Compass

A subtle compass at the top of the screen shows cardinal directions, waypoints, and known player positions, as far as Minecraft provides this information client-side.

### Waypoints

Create your own waypoints, manage them in-game, and display them in the compass or as beacon/marker indicators.

### Fullbright

Enable a brighter view without having to change the video settings every time.

### Inventory and Container Helpers

Sort inventories and containers faster. Additional useful buttons are included, such as Sort, Matching, and Container Search.

### Container Search

Search opened containers for specific items to find things more quickly in large chests.

### Locked Hotbar Slots

Lock specific hotbar slots so important items do not accidentally get moved around while sorting or transferring items.

### Durability Warning

Receive a warning when tools, weapons, or armor pieces are about to break.

### Death Marker

After death, a marker can be placed so you can more easily find your last death location.

### Inspector HUD

Shows helpful information about blocks or entities you are looking at.

### Ingame Config

Many features can be enabled or disabled directly in-game through a dedicated config screen.

## Client-only

Bzz Bzz Client Helper is a **client-side mod**.
It does not need to be installed on the server.

Some information, such as exact player positions outside the normal server tracking distance, cannot be reliably displayed client-side only. Because of this, the mod only shows data that Minecraft actually provides to the client.

## Default Keybinds

* **G** — Toggle Fullbright
* **N** — Create new waypoint
* **M** — Open Waypoint Manager
* **O** — Open Bzz Bzz Config

Additional features can be freely assigned through Minecraft’s controls menu.

## Goal of the Mod

Bzz Bzz Client Helper is designed to make Minecraft more comfortable to play without feeling overloaded.
Many features are disabled by default and can be enabled as needed.
